# Sandra K Decker CPA

Sandra K Decker CPA is a solo CPA office in Woodland Hills, California.
The office is at 5850 Canoga Avenue, Suite 400, Woodland Hills, CA 91367.
Mailing address is PO Box 4034, West Hills, CA 91308.
Services are individual tax preparation, business tax preparation, tax planning, IRS audit representation, bookkeeping, payroll, QuickBooks setup and training, and estate and trust tax returns.
Clients include business owners, executives, independent professionals, dental practices, law firms, and real estate professionals.
The office offers a free initial consultation.
